items.title: T3 Code: One app to steer multiple coding agents, from your phone to your own machine
items.summary: Stable v0.1.5, released October 29: a server on your own machine wraps Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Antigravity and more, with iOS, Android, web and desktop clients for remote thread viewing, diff review and one-click PR creation; remote access via Tailscale, SSH or a managed relay. MIT-licensed, bring your own subscriptions.

items.title: asklog 2.0 “Chief”: Give a fleet of coding agents a boss that only brings decisions to your phone
items.summary: Launched November 2: describe a job in plain words and Chief splits it into tasks, starting a Claude Code or Codex worker for each in its own git worktree, tracking progress and coming to you only for decisions; nothing merges without your approval. Works across your computers, with phone viewing and replies.

items.title: One Roof: One console for “chorus coding” on Mac, with a single inbox for every agent question
items.summary: Launched November 2: sessions of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Kimi, Antigravity and more run side by side in real terminals, one Inbox gathers everything they ask, and about 25 watch-and-report loops plus an overnight morning page keep you up to date. Open source (MIT), for Apple silicon Macs.
